scope: Static model/reference/weight layout only; no RTL, image, FPGA inference or RK equivalence claim

execution_contract.dense: Full512 C32/K16 raw CMAC, finite FP16 inputs/weights/output, donor accumulator candidate policy
execution_contract.host: Embedding/RMSNorm/RoPE/attention/SwiGLU/residuals/sampling; explicit model operators, no dense fallback
execution_contract.layout: Offline constant weight packing. Runtime result compaction must execute in hardware before host byte readback.
execution_contract.compaction_candidate: Two source-evidenced raw EW MUL-by-unity16 tasks per32-output tile; requires exhaustive finite bit-preservation proof before admission
execution_contract.raw_boundary: Unchanged production final writer must produce both CMAC and EW commands; no tensor-operation transport

remaining_gates: Actual TinyStories projection commands via original final writer
Explicit host/full512/EW ownership and command selection
Physical first projection, then all five layers and generated tokens with independent logits audit
